{{MissingInfo|1|java}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Electric| trainername=Goh| pokemonname=Raichu| jtrainername=ゴウ| jpokemonname=ライチュウ| tmtrainername=Go| tmpokemonname=Raichu| image=[[File:Goh Raichu.png|250px]] | caption=Goh's Raichu | gender=FemaleConfirmed via [[List of Pokémon with gender differences|gender differences]].| ability=Unknown| location=[[Kanto]] | evolution=1| epnum=JN035| epname=Gotta Catch a What?!| numeps1=less than 1| firststagename=Pikachu| secondstagename=Raichu| firstevoep=JN035| firstevoname=Gotta Catch a What?!| prevonum=025 f| evo1num=026 f| current=[[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]]| java1=Unknown| java2=[[Kei Shindō]]| enva1=[[Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld]]| enva2=[[Casey Mongillo]]| }} '''Goh's Raichu''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのライチュウ''' ''Go's Raichu'') is the thirtieth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] obtained in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his fifty-ninth overall. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== [[File:Goh and Raichu.png|thumb|left|250px|Raichu and Goh]] {{p|Raichu}}, as a {{p|Pikachu}}, first appeared in [[JN035|''Gotta Catch a'' What?!]] living alongside a group of other Pikachu and Raichu. She discovered [[Goh]], {{Ash}}, and [[Ash's Pikachu]] while Goh searched for a Pikachu to capture and quickly became friends with Ash's. While bonding, Goh threw a {{i|Poké Ball}} at her and successfully captured her. She proceeded to shock him with {{m|Thunderbolt}} after being called back out. Soon after, she led the group to the Pikachu group, where they were revealed to be digging for [[Thunder Stone]]s. She proceeded to dig one out and offered it to Ash's Pikachu, who adamantly refused it, though she continued to chase after him with it. After Ash explained to Goh that his Pikachu preferred to be just Pikachu, she stopped chasing him and gave the Thunder Stone to Goh, also wanting to remain a Pikachu. Right after, {{TRT}} showed up and began stealing the Pikachu and Raichu, including Ash's. In order to save the other Pikachu, she told Goh to throw the Thunder Stone to her as she was sucked into the machine, [[Evolution|evolving]] into Raichu in the process. The Evolution caused her to break the vacuum and alongside her fellow Raichu, proceeded to unleash a Thunderbolt that freed the Pikachu. In ''[[JN053|Healing the Healer!]]'', Goh managed to catch an injured {{TP|Goh|Suicune}} that a group of {{OBP|Pokémon hunters|JN053}} were trying to capture. After escaping, Raichu helped collect some {{Berries}} to help the [[Legendary Pokémon]] recover. In ''[[JN070|Take My Thief! Please!]]'', during a confrontation between [[Goh's Greedent]] and {{TP|James|Morpeko}}, Raichu handed the two a large amount of Berries to calm them down. Goh took advantage of this to try to catch Morpeko, but failed. Later, Raichu was seen helping handing food to Goh's other Pokémon, including bringing some to his secluded {{TP|Goh|Drizzile}}. In ''[[JN073|Grabbing the Brass Ring!]]'', Raichu joined Goh's Pokémon to help motivate the brass leader of {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Falinks}} when it became separated from its troops. Raichu offered everyone Berries and had them work together to act as a temporary replacement for the troops. During the attempts, Raichu used her tail to guide [[Goh's Cinderace]] into the group, who was having difficulties. Soon after, they found the missing Falinks. In ''[[JN096|Lighting the Way Home!]]'', Goh used Raichu, alongside Ash's Pikachu and [[Sophocles's Togedemaru]], to power up [[Molayne]]'s {{p|Ampharos}} so that its light could reach a space probe approaching the planet. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Raichu was seen helping out at a surprise party thrown by the Laboratory members for Goh and Ash to commemorate their departure. {{left clear}} ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Pikachu gender difference anime.png|thumb|left|250px|As a Pikachu, with [[Ash's Pikachu]]]] [[File:Raichu feeding Pokemon.png|thumb|250px|Raichu feeding Goh's other Pokémon]] In the daily life of [[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]], Raichu is the Pokémon responsible for feeding the other Pokémon that live there. Raichu is a very docile and friendly Pokémon; whenever she finds some {{Berries}} or items she offers them to other people and Pokémon, most notably for {{AP|Pikachu}}. Even when they refuse, she is insistent on offering something to them. In ''[[JN094|Suffering the Flings and Arrows!]]'', Raichu was the first Pokémon to interact with the newly caught Goh's {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Lilligant}}, offering her a Berry, proving to be quite receptive to new Pokémon arriving at the Laboratory. Raichu has a special affection for [[Ash's Pikachu]], either interacting with him while eating, or giving items specifically to him. Though she did not initially want to evolve after learning why Ash's Pikachu refused to, she eventually understood and respected his wishes. However, when {{TRT}} stole the Pikachu, she decided to evolve into Raichu in order to free them. [[JN053|Later]], Raichu's knowledge of Berries proved useful when Goh’s newly captured {{TP|Goh|Suicune}} had been badly injured after an encounter with a gang of Pokémon Hunters. Raichu is seen as a peacemaker, promptly resolving the conflict between {{TP|Goh|Greedent}} and {{TP|James|Morpeko}}. This is seen again later when she replenishes their food the next day, though Morpeko had already left the Cerise Laboratory. Raichu again uses this skill to help motivate a {{p|Falinks}} by guiding her teammates. ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{electric color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{electric color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{electric color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Pikachu|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Goh Pikachu.png|250px]] |} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|Electric||Goh {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Pikachu Thunderbolt|1=Raichu Thunderbolt|2=Raichu Nuzzle}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Thunderbolt

In the second one, ''Nighttime at the Sakuragi Park'', Raichu is mentioned by {{Ash}} while sleeping together with {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Pansear}} and {{TP|Goh|Panpour}}.https://twitter.com/anipoke_PR/status/1509455535799619589 ==Trivia== [[File:Thunder Stone JN035.png|thumb|200px|The Thunder Stone Pikachu used to evolve]] * Raichu's capture marks the first time a main character other than {{Ash}} has obtained a {{p|Pikachu}}. * Raichu is the first main character's Pokémon to evolve via an [[Evolution stone]] since [[Brock's Lombre]] in ''[[AG105|Once in a Mawile]]'', 741 episodes earlier. * Raichu is Goh's first Pokémon to evolve by a method other than by gaining [[experience]]. * Raichu is Goh's first {{type|Electric}} Pokémon. * Raichu is the first Pokémon belonging to one of [[Ash's friends]] to evolve in the same episode it was caught while being under its Trainer's ownership. ==References== ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo1|Pikachu|Raichu}} {{Goh's Pokémon|electric}} {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Goh's Pokémon|Raichu]] [[Category:Female characters (Pokémon)|Raichu]] [[es:Raichu de Goh]] [[fr:Raichu de Goh]] [[it:Raichu di Goh]] [[ja:ゴウのライチュウ]] [[zh:小豪的雷丘]]
